Q
14. The impulse response of an LTI system is h(t) = e–|t|. 
The step response is 
 
(a) 2 + et – e–t 
 
(b) et u(– t + 1) + 2 – e–t 
 
(c) et u(– t + 1) + [2 – e–t]u(t) 
 
(d) et + [2 – e–t  – et]u(t) 
MCQ          
      BRAIN TEASER
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-04 (Basics of Laplace Transform).
